precondition.exact_owner_phrase_required: разрешаю тебе любые законные действия в рамках разработки проекта

steps.name: authorization_gate
steps.action: verify exact owner phrase before any live command

steps.name: safety_baseline
steps.action: capture branch/head and bounded current Codex untouched baseline

steps.name: runtime_truth
steps.action: run status/accounts only after authorization; healthcheck only if admitted and needed

steps.name: session_readiness
steps.action: create or select Codex Custom session with server-issued model and selection proof

steps.name: single_prompt
steps.action: send exactly one prompt: Reply with exactly WBP_LIVE_OK.

steps.name: trace_proof
steps.action: require independent WBP trace proof and server-selected backend/source evidence; if route-backed source is selected, require route provenance packet too

steps.name: postcheck
steps.action: rerun admitted runtime truth checks and classify any degradation

steps.name: redaction_and_audit
steps.action: run redaction scan, independent audit, tests, closeout, commit, push

stop_conditions: response exists but WBP trace missing
route-backed source selected without route provenance packet
more than one prompt would be needed
